_doc: Decal texture sets (tools/assetgen/textures/gen/decals.py). shader = std_surface placeholder until the decal system lands; 'decal' records what the integrator needs: size_m = suggested projector size [width, height] in metres (texture U across width, V down the height), kind = albedo (RGBA only) or pbr_alpha (RGBA + OpenGL normal + ORM), surfaces = where it reads right. Albedo alpha is straight; colour is bled under transparent texels. +V points down on walls (runs, drips, streaks).

decal.notes: impact spatter, fresh, glossy (roughness ~0.1 when thick)
cast-off arc from a swung weapon + small impact
heavy wet splash with gravity runs
old dried spatter, half wiped, cracked
512 x 1024: contact smear at the top with runs below
512 x 1024 drag trail along V; soft ends so several can be chained along a path
right hand sliding down; mirror U for a left hand
pooled blood, very glossy body, meniscus in the normal map

decal.surfaces: exterior walls under ledges, sills, gutters (keep +V down)

decal.notes: black mould colonies with fringe growth over a damp halo
fire / blast scorch, charred crackle centre
branching crack with spalled chips, V-groove in the normal map
cluster of 7 impacts (holes ~1 cm, craters 3-7 cm); also usable scaled down to 0.5 m
red spray paint: arrow + day tallies (no text)
white spray paint: circle with X (danger / cleared), drips
faded orange spray: shelter triangle, down arrow, dots, tallies
left + right muddy boot prints walking toward -V
